_doc: Placement and parallelism rules per inference engine, read from each engine's source. Fitted cycle costs are NOT stored here; validate.py fits them from calibration runs every time.

esp32ai-c-int8.source: refs/esp32-ai/runtime/llm.h + firmware/*/ *.ino: 44 tensors staged int8 in PSRAM, fp32 row scale; embedding and PLE rows from mmap flash; KV fp32 PSRAM; matvec_par splits rows>=128 across both cores; attention single core

tinyllm-rust-int4.source: refs/esp32-tinyLLM engine/llm-firmware README: core int4 read in place from mmap flash (group 128, fp16 scale); head staged packed int4 in PSRAM; every matvec and attention heads split across both cores; KV fp32 PSRAM
